title: Food and drink · Challenge review
subtitle: Unit 2A challenge: food and drink, countable and uncountable nouns, a/an/some/any, and/but/or

blocks.title: Food and drink + grammar in context
blocks.text: Это не повторение один в один. Здесь нужно вспоминать слова без вариантов ответа, выбирать грамматику по ситуации и одновременно следить за a/an/some/any, countable/uncountable nouns и связками and, but, or.

blocks.title: Countable and uncountable nouns; a, an, some, any
blocks.text: Если нужно, быстро повтори правило. Затем постарайся выполнять упражнения без подсказки.

blocks.title: 1. Vocabulary recall. Complete the food and drink words.
blocks.instructions: Вариантов ответа нет. Прочитай английскую подсказку и впиши слово или фразу целиком. Первая буква дана.

items.prompt: This drink has bubbles. I often choose it instead of lemonade: s________ w________
A green vegetable with a thick stem and small green heads: b________
Small seafood that is often pink when cooked: p________
A breakfast food that you often eat with milk or yoghurt: c________
Small green or purple fruit that grows in bunches: g________
A long green vegetable that is often used in salads: c________
A soft food made from milk, often eaten with fruit for breakfast: y________
You can put this on a salad before you eat it: o________
Long thin pieces of food, often served hot with vegetables: n________
Small red fruit often used in a fruit salad: s________

blocks.title: 2. Dinner plan. Complete the conversation with a, an, some or any.
blocks.instructions: Здесь важен контекст всего диалога. Впиши только a, an, some или any в каждый пропуск.

segments: A: Let's make dinner. Have we got

chicken.
A: That's OK. Are there

cucumber too.
A: Great. Have we got

oil for the vegetables?
B: Yes. Would you like

sparkling water?
B: No, we haven't got

blocks.title: 3. Choose the only correct sentence for the situation.
blocks.instructions: Смотри не только на a/an/some/any, но и на singular/plural и countable/uncountable nouns.

items.prompt: You want to know if there is bread at home.
You offer yoghurt to a guest.
There is no rice in the kitchen.
You order one apple.
You talk about prawns as a food you like in general.
There are several eggs in the fridge.
options: There are an eggs in the fridge.
There are any eggs in the fridge.
There are some eggs in the fridge.

items.prompt: You ask a friend if they want one pear.
You politely ask for broccoli at the table.
options: Can I have a broccoli, please?
Can I have some broccoli, please?
Can I have an broccoli, please?

blocks.title: 4. Two rules at once. Choose the best completion.
blocks.instructions: В каждом пункте нужно одновременно правильно выбрать грамматику и связку and, but или or.

items.prompt: We've got ___ rice, ___ we haven't got ___ chicken.
Would you like ___ apple ___ a pear?
I usually have ___ yoghurt ___ ___ grapes for breakfast.
There aren't ___ tomatoes, ___ there is ___ cucumber.
Can I have ___ bread ___ ___ cheese, please?
I don't eat ___ meat, ___ I like fish.
Let's buy ___ melon ___ ___ strawberries for dessert.
Have we got ___ eggs, ___ do we need to buy ___?

blocks.title: 5. Challenge writing: plan a healthy dinner for two.
blocks.instructions: Напиши 9–12 предложений. Представь, что ты проверяешь продукты дома и планируешь ужин на двоих. Обязательно: минимум 8 слов из Food and drink; a и an хотя бы по одному разу; some минимум два раза; any и в вопросе, и в отрицании; минимум одно существительное во множественном числе и два uncountable nouns; используй and, but и or; задай минимум один вопрос и сам(а) на него ответь. Не копируй примеры из предыдущих упражнений целиком.

items.prompt: Write your dinner plan. Try to make the sentences connected, not just a list.
